thread:
Alex H: quick async check — sprint checkpoint for runtime perf. focus areas: kernel microbatch changes (PR #412), continuous-batching rollout, and KV-cache warmup tuning. posting current owners and blockers, pls ack or update ownership if different.

Morgan L: acked. I own kernel microbatch PR review + perf tests. timeline: aim to merge Wed EOD if CI green.

Tara P: I can take point on continuous-batching rollout plan. want to coordinate with infra for canary windows. tentative rollout Thu morning.

Sameer S: kv-cache warmup: I pushed a WIP heuristic change that prefetches top-8 keys for new sessions. putting link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/changes/kv-warmup. Needs review from Morgan (impact on memory) and Priya (SLO implications).

Priya K: noted. I'll run a quick SLO sim today and post numbers. Quick question — what's the expected mem bump? Sameer, can you paste the `perf stats` snippet?

Sameer S: paste: ```
# warmup perf snapshot
before: resident=2.1GB, avg-lat=3.8ms
after:  resident=2.6GB, avg-lat=3.0ms
```

Priya K: thanks — memory +500MB looks okay for p95 latency win, but need to validate under bursty traffic. I'll run spike tests in staging.

Alex H: ownership summary (update if I missed): kernel microbatch -> Morgan, continuous-batching rollout -> Tara, kv-warmup heuristics -> Sameer, SLO sims -> Priya. Can we add an infra contact for canary networking? @devops-bot who is on-call for Thu 09:00-12:00?

devops-bot: On-call rotation for 2024-04-03 09:00-12:00: Morgan L (primary), Elena R (secondary).

Morgan L: cool with canary support window. I'll also add a short smoke test in the deploy pipeline: `./scripts/smoke_runtime.sh --batching-check`

Tara P: for rollout steps I propose: 1) small canary (5%) with `microbatch=true`, 2) observe p95 < 50ms & error rate < 0.1%, 3) ramp to 50%, 4) full. any objections?

Priya K: add a regression eval on our worst-case prompts list before ramp to 50%. I'll attach the eval job to the canary job.

Sameer S: FYI there's a dependent PR in infra that changes socket backlog tuning, might affect observed latency under heavy batching. tagging infra owners: @alex-infra. we should coordinate so canary includes both changes.

Alex H: good catch. action items: Morgan - finish kernel PR review (WED EOD), Tara - open rollout runbook by EOD today, Sameer - update kv-warmup PR with perf snapshot and memory caveat, Priya - run SLO sims and attach eval, Morgan+Elena - be available for Thu canary window. Reply with short status updates here when done.

Morgan L: will do, pinging reviewers on PR now.

Tara P: creating runbook and linking to this thread in docs, ETA 4pm.

Sameer S: updating PR with snapshots + note about socket backlog dependency. done in draft.

Priya K: kicked off sims, will post results in ~2h.

Alex H: thanks team. if anyone hits blockers mention @alex-h directly. small ask: when you merge, add a single-line changelog entry under `runtime/CHANGELOG.md` so product can track. :thumbsup:

Morgan L: noted, will add changelog.

devops-bot: Canary deploy triggered for canary ID c-2024-4-3-001 (scheduled). Good luck! :rocket:
